predict_age.title: Predict age from a name
predict_age.description: Estimate the age of a person with a given first name, from Agify's data on people with that name, optionally for one country. age is null when there is no data; count says how many records the estimate rests on.

name.description: A first name, e.g. michael. Full names work but the first name is what is scored.

country_id.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, to predict for that country's population.

output.description: name, age (years, or null), count and country_id when localized.

predict_age_batch.title: Predict ages for several names
predict_age_batch.description: Estimate ages for up to 100 first names in one request. Each name counts against the quota.

names.description: Names to score, up to 100; each counts against the quota.

output.description: One {name, age, count} per name, in order.

predict_gender.title: Predict gender from a name
predict_gender.description: Estimate whether a first name belongs to a man or a woman, with the probability and the number of records behind it, optionally for one country. gender is null when there is no data.

name.description: A first name, e.g. michael. Full names work but the first name is what is scored.

country_id.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, to predict for that country's population.

output.description: name, gender (male, female or null), probability (0-1) and count.

predict_gender_batch.title: Predict genders for several names
predict_gender_batch.description: Estimate the gender of up to 100 first names in one request. Each name counts against the quota.

names.description: Names to score, up to 100; each counts against the quota.

output.description: One {name, gender, probability, count} per name, in order.

predict_nationality.title: Predict nationality from a name
predict_nationality.description: Estimate which countries a person with a given name most likely comes from, as up to five ISO country codes with probabilities.

name.description: A name; surnames are often more telling than first names here.

predict_nationality_batch.title: Predict nationalities for several names
predict_nationality_batch.description: Estimate the likely countries of origin for up to 100 names in one request. Each name counts against the quota.

names.description: Names to score, up to 100; each counts against the quota.

output.description: One {name, count, country} per name, in order.
